info.name: UmrahMart - Pesanan Saya (Customer)
info.description:
Postman collection untuk **Pesanan Saya** (Customer My Orders).

Base URL: `http://localhost:8080/api/v1`

## Endpoints
1. **Login Customer** — dapatkan token (otomatis disimpan)
2. **List Order Statuses** — `GET /order-statuses` (daftar status order)
3. **List Orders** — `GET /users/orders` (daftar pesanan customer)
   - Filter: status, page, limit
4. **Detail Order** — `GET /users/orders/:orderId`
5. **Get Shipping Info** — `GET /users/orders/:orderId/shipping`
6. **Get Invoice** — `GET /users/orders/:orderId/invoice`
7. **Complete Order (Pesanan Diterima)** — `POST /users/orders/:orderId/complete` (received → completed)
8. **Cancel Order** — `POST /users/orders/:orderId/cancel` (pending_payment/paid/processing → canceled)

## Flow Normal
```
Login → List Orders → Detail Order → Shipping Info → Invoice → Complete Order
```

## Flow Cancel
```
Login → List Orders → Detail Order → Cancel Order
```

## Status Tabs (UI Mapping)
- **Belum Dibayar** = `pending_payment`
- **Dikemas** = `processing`
- **Dikirim** = `shipped`
- **Sampai/Diterima** = `received`
- **Selesai** = `completed`

## Auth
Semua endpoint (kecuali login dan order-statuses) membutuhkan **Bearer token** customer (role: `customer`).

request.description:
Login sebagai customer untuk mendapatkan JWT token.

Token disimpan otomatis ke variable `customer_token`.

Mengambil daftar status order yang tersedia. **Public endpoint** (tidak perlu token).

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "order statuses loaded",
  "data": ["pending_payment", "paid", "processing", "shipped", "received", "completed", "canceled", "refunded"]
}
```

Mengambil **semua pesanan** milik customer.

**Query Params:**
- `page` (int, default: 1) — halaman ke-n
- `limit` (int, default: 10) — jumlah per halaman
- `status` (string, optional) — filter status: `pending_payment`, `paid`, `processing`, `shipped`, `received`, `completed`, `canceled`

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "orders retrieved successfully",
  "data": [
    {
      "order_id": "uuid",
      "items": [
        {
          "product_name": "Sajadah Premium",
          "selected_variant": "Hijau - L",
          "image_url": "https://storage.example.com/products/sajadah.jpg",
          "qty": 2,
          "unit_price": 150000
        }
      ],
      "total_payment": 320000,
      "order_date": "2026-03-11T10:00:00Z",
      "status": "processing"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 10,
    "total_items": 5,
    "total_pages": 1
  }
}
```
Filter pesanan: **Sampai/Diterima** (status `received`). Customer bisa klik "Pesanan Diterima" untuk menyelesaikan pesanan.

request.description:
Mengambil **detail lengkap** satu pesanan customer.

**Auto-receive:** Jika status order `shipped` dan kurir mengonfirmasi delivered, order otomatis diupdate ke `received`.

**Response Structure:**
```json
{
  "shipping": {
    "courier": "J&T Express",
    "tracking_number": "JT272936382",
    "status": "Paket telah diterima",
    "status_date": "2026-03-15 14:00"
  },
  "address": {
    "name": "John Doe",
    "phone": "08123456789",
    "street": "Jl. Merdeka No. 1",
    "district": "Menteng",
    "city": "Jakarta Pusat",
    "province": "DKI Jakarta",
    "postal_code": "10110"
  },
  "store": {
    "vendor_id": "uuid",
    "name": "Toko Umroh"
  },
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "Sajadah Premium",
      "variant": "Hijau - L",
      "image_url": "https://storage.example.com/products/sajadah.jpg",
      "price": 150000,
      "qty": 2,
      "subtotal": 300000
    }
  ],
  "payment": {
    "method": "QRIS",
    "invoice_id": "INV-ODR-242727"
  },
  "order": {
    "order_no": "ORD-20260311-XXXX",
    "order_time": "2026-03-11T10:00:00Z",
    "payment_time": "2026-03-11T10:05:00Z",
    "shipping_time": "2026-03-12T08:00:00Z",
    "delivered_time": "2026-03-15T14:00:00Z"
  },
  "summary": {
    "subtotal": 300000,
    "shipping_fee": 8000,
    "service_fee": 12000,
    "grand_total": 320000
  },
  "actions": {
    "can_cancel": false,
    "can_complete": true,
    "can_review": false,
    "can_contact": true
  }
}
```

**Actions Logic:**
- `can_cancel`: true jika status `pending_payment`, `paid`, atau `processing`
- `can_complete`: true jika status `received`
- `can_review`: true jika status `completed`
- `can_contact`: true kecuali status `pending_payment` atau `canceled`

**Menyelesaikan pesanan** — customer mengonfirmasi telah menerima barang.

**Pre-condition:** Order harus berstatus `received`.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "order completed successfully",
  "data": {
    "order_id": "uuid",
    "order_status": "completed",
    "payment_status": "paid",
    "completed_at": "2026-03-16T10:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

**Note:** Jika customer tidak mengklik tombol ini, order akan otomatis completed setelah 3 hari (via scheduler).

**Membatalkan pesanan** — customer membatalkan order.

**Pre-condition:** Order harus berstatus `pending_payment`, `paid`, atau `processing`.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "order canceled successfully",
  "data": {
    "order_id": "uuid",
    "order_status": "canceled",
    "canceled_at": "2026-03-11T12:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

**Note:** Stok produk akan otomatis dikembalikan setelah pembatalan.
